label: Insane Look streetwear drops
text: On Insane Look, limited drops only convert when the brand voice, product page, and Meta creatives feel like one system — not three separate jobs.

label: The Wolf Cloth seasonal lines
text: The Wolf Cloth taught me seasonal apparel needs cleaner catalog structure and offer framing before ads can scale without wasting spend.

label: Islamic Center Firozabad hub
text: Islamic Center Firozabad proved community platforms need the same craft as commerce: clear architecture, trust, and tools people return to.

label: Trends Sole perfume & watches
text: Trends Sole showed perfume and watch ecommerce need scent/story and product photography that feel premium — cheap creatives kill perceived value before checkout.

label: Hey Gentleman footwear
text: Hey Gentleman needed footwear catalog clarity — size confidence, lifestyle shots, and offers that sell the pair, not just the brand logo.

label: Ranglook ethnic wear
text: Ranglook taught me ethnic wear discovery is visual first: fabric feel, occasion tagging, and festive calendars beat generic “new arrivals” grids.

label: POP Naari ethnic brand
text: POP Naari’s Indo-western line only felt modern when merchandising and brand tone matched how younger women actually shop festive looks.

label: Russh Clothing streetwear
text: Russh Clothing reinforced that streetwear sells on drop energy — identity, scarcity, and ad creatives have to feel like the same crew.

label: Jaipur Tex sarees
text: Jaipur Tex saree work is trust-heavy: weave detail, drape photography, and clear occasion filters reduce returns more than louder ads.

label: Thredsy clothing & shoes
text: Thredsy needed one brand system across apparel and footwear — mixed categories confuse ads unless the look and offer language stay unified.

label: D2C skincare brand
text: A D2C skincare brand we rebuilt around ingredient clarity and routine pages saw stronger add-to-cart once ads matched the PDP promise.

label: Jaipur jewelry label
text: A Jaipur jewelry label stopped boosting random product shots and started UGC try-on clips — CAC dropped because the creative looked like proof, not polish.

label: Tier-2 salon chain
text: A salon chain in a Tier-2 city filled weekday slots after we rebuilt local SEO landing pages and Google Ads around service + locality intent.

label: Edtech course funnel
text: An edtech course offer only worked after we rewrote the sales page around outcomes and synced Meta remarketing to the exact module names.

label: Cloud kitchen brand
text: A cloud kitchen brand wasted budget on broad interest until we rebuilt creatives around delivery time, packaging, and city-specific offers.

label: Interior design studio
text: An interior studio’s website looked premium but leaked leads — a simpler brief form plus WhatsApp routing doubled qualified conversations.

label: Fitness coaching app
text: A fitness coaching Android app improved retention after onboarding screens matched the Meta ads promise instead of dumping users into a blank dashboard.

label: Noida real-estate project
text: A Noida project site ranked for intent keywords only after we split pages by BHK, possession, and locality — then fed those URLs into Google Search campaigns.

label: Fashion resale store
text: A fashion resale Shopify store gained trust with condition grades, photo standards, and UGC unboxings instead of stock-looking catalog shots.

label: B2B SaaS landing
text: A B2B SaaS landing page converted demos after we cut fluff, added role-based sections, and aligned LinkedIn/Meta messaging to the same pain line.

label: Handmade home décor brand
text: A handmade décor brand’s ROAS improved when product stories explained craft time — buyers paid more when the brand felt human.

label: Multi-doctor clinic
text: A clinic brand system (logo, tone, appointment UX) reduced no-shows because WhatsApp reminders and the site finally spoke the same language.

label: Beauty UGC sprint
text: A beauty brand’s UGC sprint beat studio ads in 10 days — raw bathroom lighting outperformed perfect sets for purchase intent.

label: Agency client rebrand
text: One agency rebrand failed until positioning was fixed first; visuals alone cannot rescue a confused offer.

label: WordPress publisher site
text: A WordPress publisher gained organic traffic after we cleaned category architecture, fixed Core Web Vitals, and wrote titles for search intent — not cleverness.

label: Shopify post-purchase upsell
text: A Shopify apparel store lifted AOV with a single post-purchase upsell tied to the exact product just bought — not a generic “you may also like” grid.

label: Android fintech onboarding
text: An Android fintech app cut drop-off by rewriting KYC screens in plain language and matching Play Store screenshots to the first session.

label: Founder personal brand
text: A founder’s personal brand started converting inbound only after content showed process and receipts — not motivational quotes.

label: Meta catalog sales
text: A Meta Advantage+ catalog campaign only scaled after feed quality, margins, and landing-page speed were fixed — creative was never the first bottleneck.

label: Google Performance Max
text: Performance Max wasted budget until we gave Google clean asset groups, strong brand negatives, and landing pages that matched query themes.

label: WhatsApp sales script
text: A WhatsApp sales script with three discovery questions beat long pitch dumps — speed to first reply mattered more than fancy CRM fields.

label: Operator discipline
text: Operating both an agency and clothing brands forced a weekly scoreboard: creative shipped, spend efficiency, and pipeline — vanity metrics got cut.

label: Freelance-to-agency path
text: Starting as a freelancer in 2020 taught me clients don’t buy hours — they buy clarity, speed, and ownership after launch.

label: Kids apparel Shopify
text: A kids apparel Shopify store reduced returns after size guides and fabric notes were redesigned for mobile thumbs, not desktop PDFs.

label: Local services ads
text: A home-services brand won calls with Google Local campaigns only after NAP consistency and review velocity were cleaned up.

label: Creator + UGC mix
text: Mixing one trusted creator with ten micro UGC clips beat a single celebrity film — diversity of faces reduced ad fatigue.

label: WordPress LMS
text: A WordPress LMS stopped leaking students after login UX, course progress, and email reminders were treated like a product — not plugins piled on plugins.
